The '''Dinosaur Hat''' is a [[Hats|hat]] that can be [[Tailoring#Hats|tailored]] using [[Cloth]] and a [[Dinosaur Egg]] at the sewing machine inside [[2 Willow Lane|Emily's house]] or the [[Sewing Machine]] received as a reward for the [[Quests#Rock Rejuvenation|"Rock Rejuvenation"]] special order. It can also be obtained from [[Desert Festival#Emily's Outfit Services|Emily's outfit services]] at the [[Desert Festival]]. There is a ≈2% chance<ref name="dinohatchance" /> to receive the gender-neutral outfit with the Dinosaur Hat.

==Notes==
* The Dinosaur Hat outfit also includes the [[File:Shirt013.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Shirts|Red Striped Shirt]] and [[File:Dinosaur Pants.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Pants|Dinosaur Pants]].<ref name="dinohatoutfit" />
